featured_verses.description: Verse of the day rotation: references like "PSA 46:10" or "LAM 3:22-23" using the app's 3-letter book ids.

announcement.description: Short message for users; empty means none.

card_styles.description: Card styles: "order" and "hidden" take style ids; "styles" maps an id to name, tags, hidden_variants, variants (id plus hex colours) and an optional "layout". An id that isn't bundled with a layout adds a new style. {} means as bundled. See remote_card_styles.example.json.

defaultValue.value: I've been turning Bible verses into quote cards with Snippet. Try it: https://snippetverses.app

invite_message.description: Text sent by Profile > Invite a friend. Empty means the bundled message.

share_caption.description: Caption sent with a shared card. Placeholders: {reference} (Psalm 46:10), {translation} (KJV), {verse} (verse text), {reference_line} (PSALM 46:10 · KJV). Empty means the bundled caption.
